subject: Mutual Action Plan: Acme Corp MAP & Next Steps

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call recap + MAP (Acme Corp)

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation. Recap below and a proposed Mutual Action Plan attached (Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx). Please confirm or edit the timeline/stakeholders so we can lock next steps.

Key pain points we heard
- Latency spikes on conversational experiences at >8k active users (esp. peak 11–3PM PT)
- High per-token cost on current vendor when using longer contexts and reranking
- Need for audit logs & customer data isolation for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Goals / success criteria
- Reduce 99th percentile latency by 30% for critical endpoints
- Cut inference cost per active session by ~20% while keeping quality parity
- Meet SOC 2 readiness requirements (logs + KMS integration) before procurement sign-off

Stakeholders (as discussed)
- Product: Avery Johnson (TA decision lead)
- Engineering: Jordan Blake (tech eval / PoC owner)
- Security/Compliance: Priya Natarajan (will lead SOC 2 questions)
- Procurement: Procurement Team (final contract / SOW)

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level)
1) PoC kick-off (2 weeks) — Redwood provides 2-week dedicated PoC environment + 1x performance benchmark run — Owner: Jordan — Target start: Apr 14, 2027
2) Security review & evidence (1 week parallel) — provide SOC 2 artifacts, KMS integration docs — Owner: Priya (Acme) & Rishi (Redwood) — Target: Apr 19, 2027
3) Pilot evaluation (3 weeks) — evaluate latency/cost with real traffic, run 1 quality eval set — Owner: Avery/Jordan — Target: May 10, 2027
4) Procurement/Legal review & SOW — finalize pricing and SOW — Owner: Procurement/Marissa — Target: May 17, 2027

Asks from us:
- Confirm stakeholders and procurement timeline
- Confirm access requirements for PoC (dedicated subnets / sample dataset)
- Suggest a 30-minute follow-up next Wed (Apr 14) to lock PoC start date

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, and dates)

Thanks — I can update the attached MAP based on your feedback and push to HubSpot after we agree.

—
Marissa Cole
